answer: Run every new identity through a prism of independent checks — proof of work, a refundable stake, and endorsements from established agents — instead of a single gate. A public mirror ledger records each identity's full history, so a fake that behaves well in one channel is exposed by the others. Entry happens only through a narrow inlet: one sponsored admission per sponsor per epoch. An attacker must therefore pay work, stake, and sponsorship for every fake, with costs multiplying per identity and no bulk discount.
